She hands out the {{badge|Electric}} to {{pkmn|Trainer}}s who defeat her. ==In the core series games== ===Role=== ====Pokémon Scarlet and Violet==== Iono first appears when the player takes on her [[Levincia Gym#Gym Test|Gym Test]], hosting a livestream titled "Where in Levincia is Mr. Walksabout?" While on stream, the player must find [[Clavell|Director Clavell]] in various locations in the city. After the player becomes [[Champion]], Iono will still be at her Gym, anticipating a visit from [[Geeta]] for a Gym inspection. She is surprised to find the player carrying out the inspection instead, but will nonetheless readily challenge the player to a battle. Once defeated, she will request that the player tell Geeta what a sensation she was during the battle. In [[The Indigo Disk]], Iono can appear in the [[Blueberry Academy]] [[League Club Room|League Club]] as a special coach, and can be found [[League Club Room/Interactions|speaking with]] [[Brassius]], [[Larry]], [[Tulip]], [[Grusha]], [[Clavell]], or [[Salvatore]]. Some mega-exclusive Iono merch!" - Iono'' ===Character=== [[File:Iono Iono Zone.png|thumb|left|250px|Iono in the "Iono Zone"]] Iono is a popular streamer and influencer from the [[Paldea]] region who runs the '''Iono Zone''' (Japanese: '''ドンナモンジャＴＶ''' ''Donnamonja TV'') {{wp|livestreaming|livestream}}, where she showcases her work as a [[Gym Leader]]."[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U9HAaHc3wnc Guess Iono’s Partner Pokémon! | Pokémon Scarlet and Pokémon Violet]." "Gweh! W-well, to be super honest... If people see you and me together...they’ll start noticin’ all the ways you’re...better than me..." - Iono'' and she doesn't like being rejected.''"Awww, c’monnn! Throw the Iono Zone a bone! We Gym Leaders should all be friendos anyway!" - Iono

Who won this time? I know, Iono! But my viewer numbers zoomed up way less than usual! Whyfore?!" - Iono'' Iono is highly animated in her movements. She often shakes with clenched teeth in awkward or tense situations and, in battle, she continuously steps up and down in place. Her oversized jacket frequently conceals her hands, so actions like waving or holding a [[Poké Ball]] are done with her coat's arms. The '''dainty''' [[Battle style (game mechanic)|throwing style]] she uses in battle is the same as the one available to the player at the League Club and is shared with [[Poppy]]. ===Challenging the Levincia Gym=== Levincia Gym Leader: Iono (AKA the Supercharged Streamer) "This Electric-type user and hit streamer is adored by the young. Her viewers’ reactions are more important to her than victory in battle, and her Gym Test is one-of-a-kind. Be ready for anything!" ===Appearance=== [[File:Iono concept art.jpg|thumb|right|Iono's reference sheet]] Iono is a small, thin woman with long arms and legs. Her age is unclear, though she has been a streamer for several years. She has distinctive teal and pink hair that reaches below her knees, styled in two wide ponytails with "bulbs" at the ends and a short pink bang shaped like a ribbon.The [[Miniature Torso Figures]] line shows that the "ribbon" is a styled part of her hair. Her contact lenses feature a gradient of colors, and her unique eyelashes have purple, triangular segments. Her natural hair color might be black, suggested by her short, thin eyebrows. Iono's teeth are jagged and shark-like, which might be a nod to the design of popular virtual YouTuber characters in the real world. ====Clothing and accessories==== Iono's outfit consists of an oversized yellow and black jacket with her logo on the front and stylized {{i|Poké Ball}}s on the sleeve straps. Beneath the jacket, she wears a silver bodysuit with a screw-like detail at the neck and a black textured outfit underneath, extending to her thighs. Her shoes, matching the bodysuit in color, have high heels and a yellow outsole, with a protruding "screw". All her clothing items feature a hexagonal pattern. She also sports a black strap on her left thigh with gray text. Two "fancy shmancy" {{p|Magnemite}}-shaped hair clips animate and mimic Iono's emotions. These clips can express various reactions and have been shown to act independently, including causing a "bzzt-bzzt-smash rampage" in [[Chargestone Cavern]]. Strangely, Iono never uses any member of the Magnemite line on her team, although she offers to [[trade]] a Magnemite to the player in [[The Indigo Disk]].

Her voice in these reveals went uncredited for a whole year until the release of ''[[PPW02|Breathe In]]'', which, in re-using audio from this animation for a short cameo featuring Iono, confirms her voice actress here was [[Fairouz Ai]].[https://twitter.com/Lewchube/status/1714648455115628990 Video comparing the same voice for Iono used in PP02] {{-}} ===Pokémon: Path to the Peak=== [[File:Iono Path to the Peak.png|thumb|250px|Iono's card in [[Pokémon: Path to the Peak]]]] A card featuring Iono, specifically [[Iono (Paldea Evolved 185)]], appeared in ''[[PTP03|Internationals]]'', used as part of [[Edgar Troy]]'s strategy. {{-}} ===Biri-Biri=== [[File:Biri-Biri Gym Leaders.png|thumb|250px|Iono in [[Biri-Biri]]]] Iono briefly appeared as a silhouette alongside the other [[Paldea]] [[Gym Leader]]s in the music video for [[Biri-Biri]]. {{-}} ==In the manga== ===Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game!=== [[File:Monjana CSV.png|thumb|left|150px|Monjana in Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game!]] '''Monjana''' (Japanese: '''﻿もんじゃな''' ''Monjana''), a [[cross-canon counterpart]] of Iono, appeared in the Scarlet & Violet arc of [[Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game! Scarlet & Violet Arc|Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game!]], where she battles against the protagonists. Her deck is themed around {{type|Electric}} Pokémon, such as {{p|Pikachu}} and {{p|Pawmi}}, and often mentions how lucky she is at the game.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2daSvA7MizU Monjana's personality appears to be similar to that of Iono's in {{g|Scarlet and Violet}}, as she maintains a thoroughly smug attitude throughout both of her battles, though her design is radically different. The {{p|Magnemite}}-shaped hairclips have been replaced with [[Master Ball]]s, and her hair now curves below her face in the shape of lightning bolts. Additionally, she now has an actual ribbon in her hair, as opposed to having her hair styled like a ribbon above her fringe. [[File:Monjana jacket CSV.png|thumb|right|150px|Monjana's Bellibolt jacket after losing]] Her design is far simpler in this manga; her sharp teeth have been removed in favor of a single fang, with further simplifications made to her boots and singular thigh high, the latter of which was removed. Just before they battled, Iono requested that Scarlet help create a battle that would get lots of views.
